facts_at_prediction.fed_hike_probability_comment: Forex Factory reported roughly 90% probability of a Fed hike after the release, versus about 70% before.
facts_at_prediction.market_reaction_comment: US equity futures remained positive but pared gains; short-dated Treasury yields rose.

predictions.mechanism: Core CPI was firmer than consensus and Fed hike odds rose sharply, while equity futures remained positive; conflicting rate and risk signals favour volatility over a forced direction.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive post-release move with falling short yields and stable Fed pricing would reduce the volatility thesis.

predictions.mechanism: Hotter core inflation raises discount-rate pressure, but the initial equity reaction stayed positive as oil pulled back.
predictions.invalidation: A sustained one-way equity move accompanied by confirming yields and Fed pricing would replace the mixed cross-asset setup.

predictions.mechanism: The CPI increases policy uncertainty while broad futures remain supported, creating two-sided index risk.
predictions.invalidation: Clear convergence of rate expectations and equity breadth into a stable directional regime.

predictions.mechanism: Higher short-rate expectations and a firmer dollar pressure gold, while geopolitical risk and elevated oil preserve safe-haven demand.
predictions.invalidation: A simultaneous sharp fall in yields and DXY, or a clear geopolitical de-escalation, would resolve the two-sided setup.

predictions.mechanism: Silver faces the same dollar/rate headwind as gold but with additional cyclical sensitivity, increasing two-sided volatility risk.
predictions.invalidation: A stable directional move in DXY, yields and broad risk assets would reduce the mixed impulse.
